newsitem.title: USA: Ohio court gives Allen unit injunction.
newsitem.headline: Ohio court gives Allen unit injunction.

text.p: Allen Group Inc said an Ohio court has granted a subsidiary a preliminary injunction against an environmental agency that was trying to stop it from selling pollution programs to another company.
In a September 23 ruling, the Ohio Court of Common Pleas granted MARTA Technologies Inc a preliminary injunction against the Ohio Environmental Protection Agency, it said.
The injunction prohibits the agency from trying to prevent MARTA from selling its centralized emissions-testing programs to Envirotest Systems Corp, it said.
"MARTA, Envirotest Systems Corp and Ohio EPA remain engaged in discussions regarding the transfer of MARTA's Cincinnati, Ohio, program to Envirotest," it said.
The programs cover the state of Maryland, Jacksonville, Fla., and Cincinnati.

In August, the company had said that MARTA had lost a contract with the agency to provide those programs in the Cincinnati area. The contract would have been worth about $11 million a year in revenues, it said.
